# <zbk-tabs>

A labelled set of mutually exclusive panels implementing the WAI-ARIA tabs
pattern with logical placement, roving focus, and retained light-DOM panels.

Base class: `.zbk-tabs`. Variant classes: `.zbk-tabs--{variant}`. Tokens: `--zbk-tabs-{property}[-{state}]`. Write `aria-*`/`role` on the element; they relocate to the internal native element. `focus()` forwards to the internal focusable.

## When to use

- Peer content sections belong in one context and switching between them is immediate.
- A compact horizontal or vertical selector is more useful than showing every section at once.
- NOT Choices navigate to distinct URLs or need browser history, middle-click, and open-in-new-tab behavior. → zbk-link
- NOT More than one section should remain visible for comparison. → zbk-accordion
- NOT The available labels cannot fit without making important choices discoverable only by horizontal scrolling. → zbk-select

## Guidance

- Pair one repeated slot="tab" label with one authored section panel, in the same order.
- Give the tablist an aria-label or aria-labelledby; the component cannot infer what the set is about.
- Keep every panel in local retained DOM when using automatic activation. Use activation="manual" if selecting a panel performs work with noticeable latency.
- Use placement for the semantic list edge; do not create a visually vertical tablist while leaving horizontal keyboard and ARIA behavior.
- Use aria-disabled="true" on a tab-slot root for an unavailable choice. Disabled tabs remain discoverable to assistive technology but are skipped by roving focus.
- Tab labels may contain presentational icons, counters, or status text but never nested interactive controls.
- Do not use tabs as page navigation.

## Attributes

| Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `selected` | `string \| undefined` | — | ID of the selected authored panel. Defaults to the first available panel. |
| `activation` | `TabsActivation` | `"automatic"` | Whether roving focus also selects, or waits for Enter/Space. |
| `placement` | `TabsPlacement` | `"block-start"` | Logical edge occupied by the tablist; inline edges produce vertical tabs. |
| `variant` | `string \| undefined` | — | Space-separated registered variant names, e.g. "ghost lg". Unknown names warn with the registered vocabulary. |

## Slots

| Slot | Description | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `tab` | Repeated visible labels adopted into generated native tab buttons and paired by index with section panels. | required |
| *(default)* | Repeated authored section panels, paired by index with tab labels and retained as focusable labelled tabpanels. | — |

- `tab`: Use inline non-interactive content. Put controls inside the associated panel.
- `tab`: Set aria-disabled="true" on the label root when its paired panel is unavailable.
- `default`: Each meaningful default child must be a section.
- `default`: An authored id becomes the public selected value and aria-controls target; otherwise Zebkit generates one.

## Keyboard

- `Tab / Shift+Tab` — Moves into the tablist on the selected tab, then out to the selected panel and its content through ordinary document order.
- `ArrowLeft / ArrowRight` — In a horizontal tablist, wraps focus through available tabs in rendered LTR or RTL direction; automatic activation also selects.
- `ArrowUp / ArrowDown` — In a vertical tablist, wraps focus through available tabs; automatic activation also selects. Horizontal lists leave these keys to page scrolling.
- `Home / End` — Moves focus to the first or last available tab and selects it under automatic activation.
- `Enter / Space` — Under manual activation, selects the focused tab. Native button activation remains the pointer and assistive-technology path.

## Events

- `change` — Native bubbling event after user activation; read `selected`.

## Examples

**Automatic activation**

```html
<zbk-tabs aria-label="Account settings"><span slot="tab">Profile</span><section id="profile-panel"><h2>Profile</h2><p>Update your public details.</p></section><span slot="tab">Security</span><section id="security-panel"><h2>Security</h2><p>Manage passwords and sessions.</p></section></zbk-tabs>
```

**Manual activation**

```html
<zbk-tabs aria-label="Reports" activation="manual"><span slot="tab">Summary</span><section><p>Summary report.</p></section><span slot="tab">Activity</span><section><p>Activity report.</p></section></zbk-tabs>
```

Manual activation lets keyboard users inspect labels without triggering panel work on every focus move.

**Vertical rail**

```html
<zbk-tabs aria-label="Workspace" placement="inline-start"><span slot="tab">Overview</span><section><p>Workspace overview.</p></section><span slot="tab">Members</span><section><p>Workspace members.</p></section></zbk-tabs>
```

**Unavailable tab**

```html
<zbk-tabs aria-label="Billing"><span slot="tab">Plan</span><section><p>Current plan.</p></section><span slot="tab" aria-disabled="true">Invoices</span><section><p>Invoices are not available yet.</p></section></zbk-tabs>
```

**Composed treatment**

```html
<zbk-tabs aria-label="Product details" variant="pills full-width"><span slot="tab">Features</span><section><p>Product features.</p></section><span slot="tab">Specifications</span><section><p>Technical specifications.</p></section></zbk-tabs>
```

## Variants

A variant is a named, partial remapping of the token surface compiled to a class. Apply via `variant="name other-name"`; different axes compose, same-axis variants are alternatives.

| Variant | Axis | Class | Description | Overrides |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `aaa` | accessibility | `zbk-tabs--aaa` | Strengthens focus, boundaries, spacing, and readable label size. | tab-font-size: {font-size.md}; tab-padding-inline: {spacing.lg}; tab-padding-block: {spacing.lg}; tab-focus-width: {border.width-lg}; tab-border-color-selected: {action.border-emphasis}; indicator-block-size: {border.width-xl}; panel-focus-width: {border.width-lg}; panel-padding-inline: {spacing.lg}; panel-padding-block: {spacing.lg} |
| `compact` | size | `zbk-tabs--compact` | Tighter labels and spacing while retaining the interaction-size floor. | tab-font-size: {font-size.xs}; tab-padding-inline: {spacing.sm}; tab-padding-block: {spacing.xs}; tab-min-inline-size: {a11y.min-interaction-size}; tab-min-block-size: {a11y.min-interaction-size}; panel-padding-inline: {spacing.sm}; panel-padding-block: {spacing.sm} |
| `enclosed` | style | `zbk-tabs--enclosed` | Bordered tabs and panel surfaces that read as one contained view. | tablist-gap: {spacing.xs}; tab-border-color: {app.border}; tab-border-color-hover: {action.border}; tab-border-color-selected: {action.border-emphasis}; tab-border-radius: {border.radius-md}; tab-canvas: {app.canvas-subtle}; tab-canvas-selected: {app.canvas}; indicator-opacity-selected: {opacity.0}; panel-border-color: {app.border}; panel-border-width: {border.width-sm}; panel-border-radius: {border.radius-md} |
| `full-width` | distribution | `zbk-tabs--full-width` | Distributes available tablist space equally across every tab. | tablist-inline-size: 100%; tab-flex: 1 1 0; tab-inline-size: 100% |
| `pills` | style | `zbk-tabs--pills` | Contained rounded selection over a lightly grouped tablist. | tablist-gap: {spacing.xs}; tablist-padding-inline: {spacing.xs}; tablist-padding-block: {spacing.xs}; tablist-canvas: {app.canvas-subtle}; tablist-border-radius: {border.radius-xl}; tab-border-width: {border.width-0}; tab-border-radius: {border.radius-xl}; tab-canvas-selected: {action.canvas}; tab-canvas-selected-hover: {action.canvas-emphasis}; tab-ink-selected: {action.ink-inverse}; tab-ink-selected-hover: {action.ink-inverse-emphasis}; indicator-opacity: {opacity.0}; indicator-opacity-hover: {opacity.0}; indicator-opacity-active: {opacity.0}; indicator-opacity-selected: {opacity.0} |
| `underline` | style | `zbk-tabs--underline` | Quiet labels over a shared rule with a selected underline. | tablist-border-width: {border.width-0}; tablist-border-block-end-width: {border.width-sm}; tablist-border-radius: {border.radius-0}; tab-border-width: {border.width-0}; tab-border-radius: {border.radius-0}; tab-canvas: transparent; tab-canvas-selected: transparent; indicator-block-size: {border.width-lg}; indicator-opacity-selected: {opacity.100} |

Custom variants: add a `zbk-tabs.variants.json` file to the base theme's token folder (component-keyed map of `{ "tabs": { "{name}": { "overrides": { ... } } } }`; token keys must exist in the table above, values are alias references or structural literals). A shipped variant name patches that variant's CSS — usable immediately. A new name compiles a new `.zbk-tabs--{name}` class and additionally needs `ZebkitElement.registerVariants(json)` before elements upgrade so `variant="{name}"` validates and applies it.

Related: `<zbk-accordion>`, `<zbk-link>`, `<zbk-select>`.
